cases.cat: Distracting presentation of material efficacy qualifier (indication/limitations of use)
cases.claim: [Visual] woman singing a jingle and choreographed dancing in a “supermarket” with produce display, rolling shopping carts, baskets and enlarged fish props, a moving seafood counter — during indication and limitations of use
cases.context: Indications and limitations of use communicated via audio, SUPERs and visuals amid fast-paced choreography, music and scene changes.
cases.rationale: Competing presentational aspects undermine the indication/limitations of use, misleading about efficacy.
cases.check: Storyboard check: flag choreography/music/scene changes during indication and limitations-of-use content.

cases.cat: Lack of fair balance / risk prominence
cases.claim: [Format] text portion of major statement: size and style of font, contrast with background, and placement on screen do not allow easy reading
cases.check: Rule: measure SUPER font size, contrast ratio and placement against legibility thresholds.

cases.claim: [Visual] hands reaching through a refrigerator display to hand milk cartons, a man stacking cans on an elaborate display, a man dancing while cleaning a wet floor, an “employee of the month” replicating a self-portrait — during major statement
cases.rationale: Interferes with comprehension of the major statement.
cases.check: Storyboard check: flag props, gags, animals and scene cuts during major statement.
